'''The Emperor's Gates''' was the name given to the gateway on the south side of [[the Wall]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. The Gates opened onto a river valley that was spanned by a bridge, and the [[Malignant Bog]] and the [[Lord Grathan's estate|estate]] of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Grathan]] were located on the south side of the bridge.
